language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The robot grasps the wooden spoon at frames 46–60 (wrist_image), lifts and transports it toward the open drawer at frames 61–119 (image, left_ego_image, wrist_image), and releases it into the drawer at frames 120–125 (image, wrist_image). At frames 130–137, wrist_image shows the spoon resting inside the drawer with the gripper withdrawn. No failed acquisition or unintended side effect is visible.
